sections.title: Guild Hub & navigation
items: Personalized first-visit onboarding with interest selection; character creation is optional.
Second-monitor Guild Hub prioritizes useful actions, commitments, recommended groups, notices, and achievement progress.
Quick create/request/join actions open from the Hub; full feature pages remain available.
Discord-style expandable sidebar replaces crowded top navigation; officer tools are grouped separately.
Screen-conscious Hub and focused page panels; large lists paginate or scroll inside the relevant panel instead of cutting off controls.

sections.title: Groups, dungeons & scheduled events
items: Separate Find Groups from Guild Events. Immediate Dungeon, Leveling, and Questing groups are not calendar events.
Dungeon group finder uses five slots (one tank, one healer, three DPS), with class/role validation and saved-character selection.
Leveling groups specify zone and level range; questing groups specify location and an optional quest.
Create and join recruiting groups through the Hub or the full Group Finder.
Scheduled raids, guild events, and custom activities stay under Guild Events, with calendar and RSVPs.
Discord group recruitment and scheduled-event synchronization use their appropriate workflows; dashboard-only group types do not falsely promise Discord posts.

sections.title: Request Board & game catalogs
items: Different request forms for Quest Help, Crafting Orders, Materials, and Other Help—questing never requests guild-bank reagents.
End-to-end request handling: post, claim, provide available supplies, mark delivered, requester confirms; statuses and audit checks prevent impersonation.
Requests can be assigned to a member’s registered main or alt; service credit only after confirmed completion.
Searchable three-panel Request Studio with catalog filters, server-side pagination, and quick access from the Guild Hub.
Bundled ForeverGuide-derived catalog: 2,033 Horde or potentially neutral quests, 2,495 profession recipes, and 591 distinct crafting materials. Live-game completeness is not certified.
Quest and recipe records preserve available source IDs, NPCs, zones, requirements, skill levels, ingredient IDs, and quantities.
WoW-style item tooltips with quality colors, descriptions and reagent hovers where verified item metadata exists.
Item icon lookup favors verified artwork and falls back to 23 item-type illustrations rather than displaying widespread question marks.
Bundled silver gauntlet cursor based on the supplied reference; ordinary text-selection cursor remains in inputs.

sections.title: Characters, profiles & member directory
items: One Discord-linked member can register a main and multiple alts, including class, roles, level and professions where provided.
Revamped searchable member directory with personalized portraits, profile previews, and member activity indicators.
Profile Studio with immediate live preview, curated fantasy portraits, emblems, scenery, themes, layouts, banners and achievement showcase.
Portrait tiles keep a proper aspect ratio; editor sections expand independently with their own scrolling when necessary.
Profile trophy badges are larger and easier to read; users can customize which earned badges to display.
Authorized officers assign an official displayed guild rank; members select presentation style but cannot promote themselves.
Member commendations highlight traits such as Helpful, Welcoming, Patient, Reliable, Leadership, and Fun to Play With.

sections.title: Achievement library & recognition
items: 48 currently active guild achievements: 30 exact Dungeon Ledger guild-achievement definitions plus 18 original CritBot service/crafting/community awards.
All 48 corresponding icons are bundled locally and appear in the catalog, award manager, member trophies, profile editor, and Discord card artwork.
Achievement names, descriptions, categories, point values, rarity, and artwork are linked to their catalog records.
Pre-1.01 achievements are archived rather than deleted; prior unlocks, reward role IDs, and historical awards are preserved.
Old achievement auto-rules are disabled when their catalog entries are archived; new award verification remains officer-controlled.
Rarity-specific achievement card art and optional original portrait/emblem assets remain available.

sections.title: Social, notifications & member preferences
items: In-dashboard notification inbox and compact bell preview cover relevant requests, groups, events, and member commendations.
Members set activity interests, dashboard theme, information density, Hub priorities, sidebar style, and notice categories.
Settings shows focused Appearance, My Activities, and Notifications panels with immediate preview instead of a wall of controls.
Important personal actions are surfaced on the member’s Hub without sending unnecessary Discord pings.

sections.title: Officer governance, feedback & operational tools
items: Granular dashboard permissions, quick-start access presets, Welcome Team notes distinct from restricted officer notes.
Corrected route-permission mapping for Find Groups so authorized users, including the guild owner, can enter.
Officer tools retain the command view, conduct records, member follow-ups, treasury ledger, and activity reporting.
Private feedback can be submitted for Bot, Discord, or Guild; officers review and triage it inside the Feedback area.
Suggestions retain dashboard/Discord submission, voting, management, and separate submission/feed channel configuration.
Channel-control refresh and manual Discord channel-ID overrides help with newly created or missing channels.
Event management, achievement awarding, profile rank changes, and member access respect the existing permission and audit rules.

sections.title: Reliability, packaging & boundaries
items: Request Studio initialization-order freeze fixed; search and category controls attach correctly.
Catalog imports and achievement migrations are idempotent and avoid replacing member data or duplicating records.
The dashboard and bot share a single canonical release number and complete version-history view.
Retired experimental integrations are not included; this release contains the Discord bot and dashboard only.
Release packages omit production database, credentials, and demo fixtures; they preserve existing environment/proxy/Docker settings.
